=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:285-297 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The UTC-day cache key is computed in the payload step before the queue wait, so a report that waits across midnight UTC saves its marker under the previous day's key.
  WHY: A later same-day report misses the cache and sends a redundant WARNING, which breaks the once-per-UTC-day guarantee. All four reviewers rated this NIT.
- .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:55-60,361-365,382-388 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Actions cache entries are branch-scoped, so a marker saved by a `workflow_dispatch` run on a non-default branch is not visible to default-branch runs.
  WHY: The next default-branch report for that repo sends another WARNING. All reviewers rated this NIT.
- .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:357-365,382-388 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Cache restore and save are not an atomic once-per-day claim, and scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:150-160, 242-255 cover only the intake run itself.
  WHY: Two concurrent same-repo reports (for example when queue acquisition fails) can both miss the cache and both send a WARNING. Minimax noted that the PR description already acknowledges this race, and rated it NIT with confidence 3. Gemini rated it NIT with confidence 5.
- .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:290 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The normalized source-repo name is truncated with `head -c 120` in the cache key.
  WHY: Repos that share the same 120-character prefix share a daily marker, so the second repo's first WARNING is sent at DEBUG. All reviewers rated this NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  WHY: Both reports send a WARNING. The reviewer notes the PR description acknowledges this as the "Known race" and reports it only to confirm the implementation matches that limitation.
